artworks.title: Funeral Scene in Imaginary Architecture
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This drawing features classical architecture with massive Corinthian columns and intricate decorations. A group of figures is depicted in a procession, carrying something significant. The composition includes detailed arches and an elaborate entablature, creating a grand atmosphere. The image includes strong lines and shadows, emphasizing depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Diana at the Bath
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.8 x 16 cm (7 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a fabric-covered surface, facing slightly to the left. One arm is extended to hold onto a draped piece of cloth. The person's head is turned forward, with a calm expression, soft eyes, and a gentle smile. Their hair is styled close to the scalp. The individual is unclothed, with detailed shading defining their form and the surrounding drapery. Folds of fabric drape around them, and there are intricate etchings of foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Diogenes Casting away his Bowl
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 45.3 x 27.2 cm (17 13/16 x 10 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an outdoor setting surrounded by trees. The scene features individuals interacting under tall, leafy trees. The trees have textured bark and branches stretching across the scene, with leaves adding depth. The foliage is rendered with fine lines, creating a lush background. The ground beneath the figures is depicted with foliage and rocks, adding texture to the environment. The intricate line work and careful depiction suggest a classic or historical narrative.

artworks.title: Plato's Cave
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 33.7 x 45 cm (13 1/4 x 17 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a print of a detailed interior scene with people in a cave-like environment. There is a contrast between the illuminated faces of the people near the entrance on the left and the people clustered in the deeper, darker parts of the cave on the right. In the center of the cave, a low wall appears to extend, trapping the people on the right into a dark, confined area. On top of this wall are small statues of people in different positions holding different objects, like long horns or scepters. Some of the statues have large wings. These statues cast shadows on the wall to the far right. To the left of center, a hanging brazier casts light on the left side of the print, below which a group of men in robes seem to converse together. Behind them is the arched opening of the cave, and beyond it we can see three distant people standing together against a pale sky. There is Latin text above and below the print.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is an image showing a central figure in elaborate robes raising its arms, surrounded by other figures in various poses. Above, there are floating figures in a heavenly tableau. The scene is detailed and shaded.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Two Beavers
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a natural scene with various animals and plants seen from a low angle perspective. The horizon is low, with a sky filled with clouds above. In the background, mountains are visible, and trees create a barrier. The detailed etching style reveals intricate details in the foliage and animals. The monochromatic color palette accentuates light, shadow, and details with black and gray tones. Near the viewer are grasses, otter-like creatures by a stream, a turtle, and a snake in the dynamic landscape.

artworks.title: Marengo
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine applique
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse standing on a piece of land with a body of water and a distant horizon. The scene captures a muscular, elegant horse at rest on a textured, grassy bank, with its mane and tail flowing softly. The landscape extends into a calm body of water beneath a vast, cloudy sky. The chiaroscuro contrasts and fine cross-hatching techniques highlight the details of the horse's anatomy and the serene atmosphere of the landscape. The drawing emphasizes the harmony between the horse and its surroundings.

artworks.title: A Baby in a Basket Outdoors (Couverture pour L'Album d'estampes originales)
artworks.medium: 5-color lithograph on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict
artworks.description: The image features a collection of abstract shapes and lines with various colors and forms. The lettering is scattered and somewhat blurred, resembling faded paint or chalk on a wall. The word "album" stands out prominently, similar to what may be seen on a vintage music poster. The letters are integrated into an abstract, organic background with earthy tones, patches of green, and white. The word "originals" is faintly visible below, floating over a textured, brownish surface resembling stone or aged paper. The design conveys a blend of natural and human-made elements in an abstract and impressionistic style.

artworks.title: Shepherds Resting by a Stream
artworks.medium: gouache and pastel on prepared canvas
artworks.creditLine: Robert H. and Clarice Smith Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is high, showing rolling hills and an old structure on a hill to the left. Figures in rustic clothing tend to a flock of sheep amidst rocky terrain and lush greenery. Trees of varying heights and a waterfall in the middle add depth and movement to the scene. The color palette consists of soft earthy tones with a clear, pale blue sky and wispy clouds. The brushwork is skillful and blends elements seamlessly.

artworks.title: Allegory on the Turkish Wars
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black inks with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with a mythical element. The drawing depicts a chaotic battle scene filled with numerous figures, armed and in combat. One figure stands prominently in the center, gesturing. Another figure is clad in armor. A unique element in the drawing is the depiction of a goat riding a fish with a sprouting flower, positioned in the clouds above the battle. The composition is circular, drawn with light colors and fluid lines capturing movement and energy.

artworks.title: Figure Studies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures. One figure is standing on the left, displaying a muscular build and a strong stance. The figure on the right is kneeling and reaching upwards with their right arm. The sketch is done in a loose, gestural style with visible contours. The background is neutral, highlighting the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: Anatomical Studies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red chalk in another hand
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two limbs, specifically an arm and a leg. On the left, there is a detailed sketch of a muscular arm extending downward, with a bent elbow and a hand with fingers slightly curled. The right side of the image features a detailed sketch of a leg extending downward with attention to musculature and toes pointed downward. The drawing is executed with fine, dark lines, showcasing intricate anatomical details. Shadows and form are suggested through the use of cross-hatching. The backdrop consists of a simple, textured paper. Touches of red chalk appear on the right side.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a full-length female figure. The woman is shown standing with a slight lean, her right leg bent at the knee. Her head is inclined to the side with closed lips. She has long hair flowing past her shoulders. The drawing does not include clothing, and the background is plain white. No jewelry or objects are shown in the sketch.

artworks.title: Orpheus and Eurydice
artworks.medium: black and white chalk with traces of graphite on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body figures. On the left is a person standing upright, wearing a long, flowing garment that covers them from neck to feet, with elaborate folds and draping. Their head is adorned with a wreath, and they have a contemplative expression. Their right hand is slightly raised, with fingers pointing. To the right, there is a fully nude figure in a contrapposto stance, with one leg slightly bent and the left foot raised. This figure rests their left hand on their hip and holds a rectangular object at their side with their right hand. They have curly hair and a direct gaze. Both figures are drawn in tones of white and black chalk on a brownish-ochre paper. Behind them, there is a plain background. The initials "E.B.J." are visible on the lower right.

artworks.title: Allegorical Figures Seen from Below
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red wash, heightened with white, over red chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various mythical or allegorical figures in dynamic poses. The drawing features several figures floating or flying across the composition, with swirling lines and fluid motion. Drapery and rhythmic lines emphasize the figures’ movement. The artist used a reddish sepia tone with soft shading to create the image, adding touches of blue to highlight parts of the garments. The figures are expressive, each carrying out different gestures. The positioning of these figures suggests a scene of mythological significance, with some appearing to hold objects like wings or instruments. The background is minimally detailed, making the figures the focal point of the composition.

artworks.title: Seated Male Nude [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 16.8 x 17.5 cm (6 5/8 x 6 7/8 in.)
support: 17.8 x 18.2 cm (7 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a seated male figure. The man is angled with his body facing slightly to the left, left arm extended outward, pointing with one finger. His right arm is bent, resting on his knee. The figure has a full beard and long, wavy hair flowing past his shoulders. His facial features are detailed yet not fully defined. The man is clothed in flowing garments that partially cover his muscular form, leaving his legs exposed. He is seated on an implied chair or throne, indicated by lines and shading behind him. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with Saints John and Luke
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash over red chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a group of serene figures and cherubs gathered around a grand tree. A central figure is holding a child, both with halos above their heads. The scene is filled with cherubic figures interacting around the main characters, with some hovering in the air. The tree is lush with foliage, extending upwards with cherubic figures among its branches. In the background, there are detailed architectural structures, contributing to the tranquil and natural atmosphere of the scene. The drawing is created with fine linework and subtle shading, resulting in a harmonious and intricate depiction.

artworks.title: Two Seated Male Figures
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch shows two individuals in a seated position, with their full bodies slightly angled towards each other. Their facial features are depicted with simple lines and minimal detail. The hair of the individuals is represented with a few lines. The clothing appears to be long robes or cloaks, characterized by flowing, draped lines. There is no jewelry or specific objects in their hands. The background of the image is plain. The overall atmosphere of the sketch is informal and rough.

artworks.title: Female Saint Carrying a Banner [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a full-body sketch of a figure standing in an elevated position. The person is holding a large object across their shoulders with both hands. Their head is tilted back slightly, and the facial features are soft with closed eyes. The hair is short and loose. They are draped in flowing garments suggestive of robes. No jewelry is visible. Additional faint figures and forms appear in the background. The background is empty apart from these light sketches, providing focus on the main figure. The artwork is monochromatic with reddish-brown tones.

artworks.title: The Apotheosis of San Vitale
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Emma P. and Fred Ziprik Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures on clouds within a circular frame. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses, with various smaller winged characters around them. One central figure stands out, with others interacting around them. The composition evokes a sense of energy and movement, with detailed line work and shading creating depth and motion in the celestial scene.

artworks.title: Fancy Pitcher
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and yellow wash
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Emma P. and Fred Ziprik Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate vessel with intricate designs. The vessel is highly decorative, featuring a sculpted lion perched on top with a long tail curling upwards. The body of the vessel showcases elaborate figures, including mythological beings and scrollwork, all rendered with delicate lines and fine detailing. The vessel appears to combine elements of classical art with fantasy, exhibiting a baroque or possibly Renaissance style of ornamentation. The level of detail and complexity highlights the artist's focus on imaginative and highly decorative compositions.

artworks.title: Allegory of Summer
artworks.medium: pen and India ink with black wash and graphite on five sheets of thin graph paper; partially squaredin graphite
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This composition features central geometric rectangles with curved and flowing lines. A square at the center swirls dynamically, surrounded by a curled form resembling movement. Two elongated figures stand on either side, with limbs stretching upwards. Below, a rectangular panel shows a reclining figure in a serene posture. The image blends abstract shapes with human forms and gestures.

artworks.title: The Peep-Show
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and yellow-brown washes over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This drawing shows multiple figures around a large box structure. The group of individuals are focused on the box, some objects are on the ground nearby. The figures are looking into the box with interest. The drawing features expressive lines and details depicting the curiosity of the scene.

artworks.title: Travellers among Roman Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red-brown and blue wash, incised for transfer
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 21.1 x 23.6 cm (8 5/16 x 9 5/16 in.)
image (diameter): 19.8 cm (7 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape enclosed within an oval frame, presenting a historical scene with Roman-style ruins. In the foreground, three figures stand near a rocky area. To the right, people with livestock move along a path. In the background, tall columns and partial structures stand among smaller human figures. The horizon slopes gently upward, with distant buildings, ruins, and trees under a softly clouded sky. The image features delicate brushwork, fine lines, and subtle shading, with an earthy color palette dominated by soft sepia tones, browns, oranges, and greys contrasting with the pale blue sky.
